posts.title: Moving on after 12 great years at Cydar, and my favourite projects
posts.description: The cover image above is of the first Cydar HQ, a converted water mill in Cambridgeshire. It was a glorious setting for a startup, and was a nice change from the corporate offices of Broadcom. 1 I was known to swim in the mill pond on hot days, and once had to chase a loose sheep! We even made some Cydar Cider 2 from the orchard on site in my first few weeks.

posts.title: Ctrl+Alt+Drink: Adventures building a garden bar with a hidden motorised drinks cabinet
posts.description: Yep, that’s me dressed as Jaws 1 from Moonraker. We had a 007 themed opening party because everyone kept saying the motorised drinks cabinet looked like something from a Bond film.
